module: "Barriers Selector" window (Gameplay > Barriers Editor menu) to choose the barrier prefabs of a level. It searches /levels/<level>/ for .prefab files matching a pattern (default *barrier*), temporarily instantiates them to read the TSStatic positions, then displays them in two lists (unselected / selected) with debug spheres in the view. A "Barriers Selection" edit mode lets you click in the view (click = toggle, Shift = add only, Alt = remove only). Menu entries synchronize the selection with the race editor (editor_raceEditor, field path.prefabs).
notes: Bug: in the Prefabs > "Load Selected Prefabs" menu, the variables filename and f are not defined in that scope (nil globals), so spawnPrefab receives nil arguments and the entry does not work properly.
Bug: M.onExtensionLoaded = onExtensionLoaded references an undefined variable (nil): the exported field is therefore nil.
In "Add Selection to Race Editor" and "Set Selection exactly", path.prefabs is read before the `if path` test (error if getCurrentPath returns nil).
onSerialize and onDeserialized are empty functions.
Prefabs are keyed by file path (prefabsIndex): a file that is already loaded is not reloaded until "Clear results" has been used.

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Is nil: reference to a local variable that is never defined.

show.desc: Deselects the editor objects and shows the "Barriers Selector" window.

onEditorGui.desc: Called every editor frame: draws the window (Load / Race Editor menus, two prefab lists, > and < buttons) and the debug spheres of each prefab.

onEditorInitialized.desc: Registers the window (1500x700), the "Barriers Editor" menu entry (Gameplay group) and the "Barriers Selection" edit mode with its mouse shortcuts.
